zoe: Quick refresh PR opened for the hello-quickstart: add PKCE flow + tiny Python snippet + note about decklink helper. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4502. Need snippet review (py + js), checksum for decklink release, and a Linux smoke test.

rahul: I'll review the JS snippet and add env var examples (REDWOOD_CLIENT_ID, AUTH_DOMAIN). Include a short curl exchange example.

ina: Please replace any references to the old cookie helper with the decklink migration one-liner. Add SDK compatibility (>=0.9.0).

ci-bot: CI: docs-build OK for PR #4502 44d preview: https://deploy-preview-4502--redwood-docs.netlify.app/hello-quickstart.html

qa-lee: Running Linux smoke (Ubuntu 22.04) now. Steps to run?

zoe: Run: npm ci ; npm run dev ; ./decklink auth --client-id $REDWOOD_CLIENT_ID --redirect http://localhost:3000/callback ; curl -X POST https://auth.example.com/token -d 'grant_type=authorization_code&code=...&redirect_uri=http://localhost:3000/callback' . Then open http://localhost:3000 and confirm the sample greeting renders.

qa-lee: Smoke done 7e5 Decklink installed, token flow completes, UI shows "Hello, test". Left one tiny wording nit on the PR.

zoe: Thanks all 680 will merge after the nitfix and a quick spellcheck.
